title: C++: Graph BFS/DFS
description: Implement BFS and DFS on a graph represented as an adjacency list.

steps.title: Graph Traversal
steps.description: Create a graph with 6 nodes using vector<vector<int>> adjacency list. Implement DFS (recursive) and BFS (queue-based) that print nodes in visitation order starting from node 0.
hints: DFS: mark visited, print, recurse neighbors.
BFS: use queue<int>, mark when enqueuing.
